author: @briettasells
caption:
Obviously, this is over simplified 👇🏽
Tips on how to build one home at a time 🗣️
▫️Purchase Your First Property as a Primary Residence ~ Start by buying your first home to live in. This helps you secure a lower interest rate and down payment.
▫️Live in the Property for at Least a Year ~ Spend at least 12 months in your new home. This meets the primary residence requirement and gives you time to get to know the property.
▫️Turn Your First Property into a Rental ~ After a year, you can convert your home into a rental. Find reliable tenants and start generating rental income. Ask me for a good PM referral!
▫️Purchase Your Next Home as a Primary Residence ~ Now, you’re ready to buy your next primary residence. Since it’s your primary, you again benefit from favorable loan terms.
▫️Offset Your Debt-to-Income Ratio (DTI) ~ When applying for a mortgage on your new home, you can use up to 75% of the rental income from your first property to offset your DTI. This makes it easier to qualify for your next loan.
This is NOT a one size fits all! Book a call in my bio to chat about wherever you’re at in this process 👏🏽
